operational-example.copy: Use Combobox when people need to type, narrow, and choose one known operational value without leaving the field context.

rationale: It covers the SelectCombo and Combobox references without expanding base Select.
It owns one editable field, filtered options, active option, empty state, clear action, and keyboard selection.
Global search, command palettes, async query policy, and multi-select remain patterns or separate components.

items.rule: Owns visible label, helper, density, validation, and disabled state.
Accepts typed filtering while preserving the selected option as text.
Signals search or entity type without replacing label text.
Clears local selection/value as a field action.
Shows filtered known options, metadata, selected state, and empty feedback.

accessibility.statePrecedence: disabled, error, open, focus, empty, filled, default
items: Use a visible label associated with the editable combobox input.
Expose aria-autocomplete=list, aria-expanded, aria-controls, and aria-activedescendant.
Keep option text and metadata available as text, not icon-only.
Show visible empty-state copy when filtering has no matches.
Return focus to the input after selecting or clearing.

variants.copy: Combobox has one base variant for editable single selection. Entity-specific filtering changes option content, not component anatomy.

states.copy: Combobox states communicate typed filtering, open options, selected value, empty results, error, and disabled behavior.

variant-state-behavior.copy: Variant stays stable; state controls open, empty, error, selected, and disabled behavior.

full-width.copy: Combobox may fill form columns, filters, and drawers while the option layer follows the field width.

responsive-layout-patterns.copy: Use roomy density for touch contexts and keep typed value, clear action, and option layer legible before placing Combobox inside a larger filter pattern.

viewport-organization.copy: Combobox remains one editable selection field. Viewport rules decide density and option layer width; query orchestration belongs to patterns.

items.title: Phone
items.rule: Use large density and avoid dense multi-column option content.

items.title: Tablet
items.rule: Keep helper copy close to the field and listbox.

items.title: Desktop
items.rule: Use compact density in filter rows only when typed value remains readable.

playground.copy: Use the playground to verify label, value, placeholder, options, empty copy, density, and state.

api-foundations.copy: Combobox API exposes one editable selection field. Design System owns field shell, option layer, state, accessibility, density, and motion; product code owns option data and search policy beyond local filtering.

groups.title: Use
items: Use for one known value when typing helps narrow options.
Keep option labels stable and human-readable.
Show empty results copy instead of a blank layer.

groups.title: Avoid
items: Do not use for global search or command palettes.
Do not use for multiple selection.
Do not hide async data loading or permission policy inside the component.

groups.title: Review
items: Check keyboard navigation and focus return.
Escalate to a pattern when filtering affects query state, saved views, or multiple fields.

rejectIf: Combobox owns global search or command execution.
Raw color, spacing, motion, or typography values are used.

miel.copy: MIEL treats Combobox as one editable selection field: agents can use it when the choices are known and local filtering is enough, while humans confirm data source, empty state, and escalation to patterns.
canDecide: Use Combobox for one known entity list with typed narrowing.
Use Select instead when typing is unnecessary.
Keep option metadata short and text-backed.
mustAsk: Options load remotely, affect URL/query state, or trigger side effects.
The user can select multiple values.
The search behaves like global navigation, commands, or support lookup across systems.
rejectIf: Combobox becomes a command palette, global search, or multi-select.
The option layer lacks visible empty-state copy.
Selected value and active option are not machine-readable.
miel.handoff: I am using Combobox for one editable known-value selection. Please confirm option source, filtering policy, empty copy, keyboard behavior, and whether this should escalate to a pattern.
